senses.gloss: m. (שָׁפָה II, v. שִׁיפּוּי II) (fatty) protuberance, cap of the hip-bone.
units: <cite ref="Chullin 92b:7">Ḥull. 92ᵇ</cite> <he>גוממו עם הש׳</he> he peels the fat off even with the cap (v. <cite ref="C01054"><he>גָּמַם</he></cite>).

Ab. Zar. 25ᵃ (expl. השוק והעליה, I Sam. IX, 24) שוק וש׳ the leg and the cap; מאי והעליה דש׳ עילויה וכ׳ (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l.) what does v’heʿaleha mean? (That which is on top of it,) for the shofi is above the leg; Y. Meg. I, 72ᶜ bot. (Chald. dict.) שקא ושׁוֹפָה.
